name: Patagosuchus
sum: Peirosaurid known from fragmentary jaw and limb remains from the Portezuelo Formation.
holotype: MANE-PV 1, a fragmentary dentary and splenial, right maxilla and jugal, a vertebra, an osteoderm and the right humerus.
